subject: Polaris: Evaluation Playbook Proposal & Kickoff
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Jenkins <laura.jenkins@polarishealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Polaris: Evaluation Playbook Proposal & Kickoff

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I put together an initial evaluation playbook and a short kickoff slide deck to help structure the pilot and the decision timeline. The goal is a tight 6-week evaluation that proves latency, cost, and integration fit so Polaris can make an informed adoption decision by mid-March.

Quick summary of what's in the draft doc:
- Success criteria: latency SLOs, cost/unit targets, security & data-flow checklist
- Test matrix: sample prompts, throughput targets, and measurement hooks
- Roles & owners: recommended internal stakeholders and Redwood points of contact
- Timeline: milestone weeks, gating criteria for pilot progress

Links (view/comment):
- Playbook (doc): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3C_POLARIS_PLAYBOOK/edit?usp=sharing
- Kickoff slides: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1XyZ_POLARIS_KICKOFF_SLIDES/edit?usp=sharing

Suggested kickoff slots: Feb 10 or Feb 12 (30–45m). Proposed agenda: 1) alignment on success criteria (10m), 2) instrumenting evals + data capture (10m), 3) timeline & risks (10m), 4) next steps & owners (5–15m).

Ask: can you confirm a kickoff slot and whether your procurement team needs a separate intro call this week? If helpful, I can loop in our contracts lead for procurement topics.

Attachments: POLARIS_EVAL_PLAYBOOK_TEMPLATE_v1.gdoc (link above), POLARIS_KICKOFF_SLIDES_v1.gslides

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0142

From: Laura Jenkins <laura.jenkins@polarishealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Feb 2026 09:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Polaris: Evaluation Playbook Proposal & Kickoff

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the materials — the playbook looks helpful and the timeline feels reasonable. A few quick notes from our side:
- Procurement will want a short checklist on data residency and logging; I can share that with you after I pull it from our security intake.
- Our preference is Feb 10 at 10:00am ET for the kickoff. 30 minutes should be fine; we may invite one more engineer to the call.
- On success criteria, can we add a durability test (simulated 12-hour peak window) so we can validate sustained throughput?

If you can confirm the time, I will send a calendar invite and include procurement on a separate thread for contract Qs.

Best,
Laura
Laura Jenkins
Director, AI Engineering | Polaris Health
laura.jenkins@polarishealth.com | (617) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Polaris: Evaluation Playbook Proposal & Kickoff

Alex / Dev —

Saw Laura's note — Feb 10 at 10:00am ET works for me. Quick internal planning items before kickoff:
- I'll own onboarding & stakeholder intro: capture primary Polaris contacts and any success criteria they add.
- Dev, can you draft the instrumentation checklist (metrics + logging endpoints + sample queries) by EOD Feb 6? We'll need that to validate the 12-hour durability test request.
- Alex, I can run through the playbook and flag any Redwood-config specifics (model variant, batching & caching settings) this afternoon.

Tentative internal owners table (we'll finalize at standup):
- Success criteria & acceptance: Laura + Marissa (Polaris / Redwood)
- Instrumentation & metric collection: Dev + Polaris engineer
- Procurement & contract questions: Alex to coordinate with procurement thread
- Pilot ops & escalation: Marissa

I'll add the agenda items you suggested and a short pre-kickoff checklist to the doc.

— Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Jenkins <laura.jenkins@polarishealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Polaris: Evaluation Playbook Proposal & Kickoff

Laura —

Thanks — Feb 10 at 10:00am ET is confirmed on our side. I'll accept once you send the invite.

Notes in response to your asks:
- Durability test: yes — Dev will include a sustained-throughput plan and an automated script we can run in week 3.
- Procurement checklist: I will loop in procurement and our legal lead; copying Marissa and Dev here so procurement has a single Redwood thread. If procurement needs a PO or standard MSP, please have them send a short list of docs/clauses.

I've updated the doc with a short "What we'll measure" table and added a call-out about logging retention and redaction guidance. Final links (view/comment):
- Playbook: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3C_POLARIS_PLAYBOOK/edit?usp=sharing
- Updated slides: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1XyZ_POLARIS_KICKOFF_SLIDES/edit?usp=sharing

Attachments: POLARIS_KICKOFF_SLIDES_v1.gslides

Looking forward to the kickoff — see you Feb 10.

— Alex
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Jenkins <laura.jenkins@polarishealth.com>, Polaris Health Procurement <procurement@polarishealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Polaris kickoff — short summary & next steps

Hi Laura (and procurement team) —

Thanks for the kickoff earlier today. Quick summary and agreed next steps:
- Pilot window: 6 weeks starting Feb 17 (instrumentation & smoke runs week 1; durability week 3; final evaluation week 6).
- Owners confirmed: Laura (Polaris) + Marissa (Redwood) for acceptance gate; Dev (Redwood) + Polaris engineer for instrumentation; Alex for procurement coordination.
- Action items (owners & due dates):
  1) Dev: instrumentation checklist + automation script for durability test — due Feb 13
  2) Polaris: provide procurement checklist / required clauses — due Feb 12
  3) Alex: share procurement contact & standard MSP + PO flow — due Feb 11
  4) Marissa: finalize playbook with gated acceptance criteria — due Feb 15

I added the tasks to the playbook and flagged items that block the Week 1 smoke runs. Link to meeting notes and the doc are in the playbook header.

If anything above looks off, flag here and I'll update the doc.

Thanks — nice kickoff.

— Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
